meta.title: Ngary · Furniture made for your home: showroom, custom orders & delivery
meta.description: Ngary furniture for the living room, bedroom, dining room and office. Made in our own workshop, made to order and delivered to your home. Call us or visit the showroom.

story.title: From a sketch to your living room
story.art: Illustration: an armchair taking shape, from a pencil sketch to a wooden frame, then upholstery, then placed in a room

s1.title: It starts with your idea
s1.body: Tell us the size, the style and the room it's for. We sketch the piece around how you live, and custom orders are welcome.

s2.title: Built in our own workshop
s2.body: The frame is made by our team, in our own workshop, before a single cushion goes on.

s3.title: Your fabric, your colour
s3.body: Choose the upholstery and finish that suit your home. The same chair looks completely different in your fabric.

s4.title: Delivered to your home
s4.body: When it's ready, we deliver it to your door. Call us to start your piece.

how.title: Four steps from a phone call to your home

s1.body: Tell us what you're looking for. We'll answer your questions and help you plan.

s2.title: Visit or describe it
s2.body: See pieces in our showroom, or describe the piece you have in mind.

s3.title: We make it

s4.title: We deliver
s4.body: Your furniture is delivered to your home.

measure.title: Measure your space
measure.intro: Have these numbers ready and we can talk about sizes straight away.
measure.art: Illustration: a room plan with width, depth, door and height measurements

s1.title: The wall or corner
s1.body: Measure the width and depth of the space where the piece will stand.

s2.title: Doors, stairs and lifts
s2.body: Check the width of every door, stairwell and lift on the way in.

s3.title: Room to move
s3.body: Leave space to walk around it and to open doors and drawers.

s4.title: Height
s4.body: For tall pieces like wardrobes and shelves, measure up to the ceiling.

faq.title: Good to know
faq.q1: Can you make a piece to my size?
faq.a1: Yes. Custom orders are welcome: tell us the size, style and room, and we will make it in our workshop.
faq.q2: Can I choose the fabric and colour?
faq.a2: Yes. You choose the upholstery and finish that suit your home, and you can see options in our showroom.
faq.a3: Yes, we deliver your furniture to your home. Call us to ask about your area and timing.
faq.q4: How long does a custom piece take?
faq.a4: It depends on the piece. Call us and we will tell you the time for yours.
faq.q5: Can I see pieces before I order?
faq.a5: Yes. Visit our showroom to see, sit on and compare pieces.
faq.q6: What is the best way to start?
faq.a6: Call us. Tell us what you need and we will guide you from there.

designer.title: Plan your room, then call us with it
designer.body: Pick a room, set the walls, floor and fabrics, add pieces and drag them into place. Your design stays on this device, so you can describe it when you call.
designer.hint: Drag pieces to move them. With a keyboard: Tab to a piece, use the arrow keys to move it and Delete to remove it.
designer.noJs: Turn on JavaScript to add and move pieces, or call us and describe your room.
